title: Database connection pool exhaustion
symptoms: Application errors: too many connections, connection timed out
Latency spike correlating with connection count
root_cause: Connection leak in application; pool size misconfigured; missing connection pooling layer; long-running idle transactions
workaround: Kill idle connections: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle' AND query_start < now()-interval '10 min'; temporarily increase max_connections (with caution)
permanent_fix: Deploy RDS Proxy or PgBouncer; set app pool max ≤ (DB max_connections / num_replicas) * 0.8; add connection leak detection; implement query timeout defaults

auto_healing.mechanism: RDS Proxy auto-scales connection multiplexing; Datadog monitor triggers runbook webhook to kill idle sessions

notes: Review per-application connection pool settings during capacity planning
